title: 第43章 陆阳，你要新班长不要？
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 滴答，滴答，滴答......药瓶倒挂在支架上，一滴滴透明药水落在滴管内，有节奏的砸出小小水花。团部医务室病床上，陆阳缓缓睁眼，仰头看了眼头顶上的药瓶。大约还剩半瓶左右，起码得一个小时才能全部挂完。原本，昨晚陆阳的烧已经退了。结果半夜突然复烧，伴随剧烈咳嗽。于是指导员连夜爬起来，开车带他来到这来挂水。野战医院的流动体检车正巧要给团部骨干做体检，随行大夫也都是三甲医院里的正规医生。测完体温，询问过症状，直接就给他开了几瓶水。昨夜里挂了两瓶，今回白天还有一大一小两瓶水。在此过程中陆阳反反复复睡了好几觉，烧逐渐退了，脑袋也不那么烫了。团里的医务室并不大，内饰是最早期的那种绿底白墙，总共只有两张病床，墙上也没个电视机。干等着实在有些无聊，陆阳便随手拿起旁边柜子上的一本《战地急救手册》翻看起来。这是一本入门级别的简易急救指南，内容并不是很多，但教的都很基础实用的东西。包括，如何在野外清理伤口，如何正确使用绷带，如何给骨折的伤员制作夹板固定等等。因为内容挺有意思，陆阳看的晶晶有味，原本略带昏沉的脑袋好像也逐步清晰明朗起来。他这才想起，在系统作用下只要学习与部队里相关专业知识，就能提升身体素质。或许，效果并不算特别明显，但聊胜于无，正好也能打发时间。正巧这时，医务室的门被推开，何镇涛提着个保温桶走进来。瞧见陆阳已经醒了，而且靠在床边认真看书，立马露出笑容。“醒了？”“指导员好。”陆阳想要抬手敬礼，却被他按了回去。“你是病号，用不着。”“我让食堂单独弄了个病号饭，你待会儿趁热吃。”何镇涛拧开保温盒，里头是一份烂乎乎的鸡蛋青菜面，还滴了几滴小磨香油。陆阳昨天吐了好几回胃里空荡荡的，这会儿闻着香味儿，还真有点饿了。“有点烫，先放边上晾一晾，正好你这瓶水快挂完了，结束再吃。”“好。”趁着等待的工夫，何镇涛将那本《战地急救手册》拿了过来，故意打趣道。“怎么，想当医疗兵？”“没有，就是随便看看，打发打发时间。”“那下连以后，你想当什么兵种？”“额......”指导员的话，一下子就给陆阳问住了。他目前擅长的，只有整理内务，出黑板报，再要不就是点评个新闻。队列虽然走的还不错，但并不是最好的； 体能，在整个连队里只能算中游；而身体素质这一项，恐怕得排倒数。当初决定放弃复读报名参军时，父母就曾担心部队不要他。那会儿，陆阳还觉得多少有点儿伤人和扎心。可事实上，父母确实要比陆阳，更加清楚他的身体状况。随着年龄增长，人们总是喜欢选择性淡忘掉记忆里很多不好的事。比如陆阳清楚记得自已小时候身体不太好，经常往医院跑，甚至大过年还感染肺炎，把一大家子弄得鸡飞狗跳。但“小时候”这三个字的年龄界限本就模糊，成年后的陆阳为了表明自已不再“体弱多病”，总是迫不及待的要跟“小时候”做切割。而这么做的很大一部分原因，也是因为“体弱”两个字，通常会和“虚”画等号。陆阳是个纯爷们，自然是不会承认自已“虚”的，以至于他主观的修改了自已的记忆，才误以为现如今已经摆脱了“药罐子”这三个字。但事实上，直到参加工作，他的身体素质也依旧没有强上许多。但凡碰上流感爆发季节，他都是最早中招的那一批。只是迫于生活压力，他并没有时间和机会像小时候那样去医院打针挂水，只能吃药硬扛。久而久之，就产生了一种，免疫力比以前更强的错觉，实则不然。而一场冬雨，打破了陆阳的体面，戳破了他给自已精心编造的谎言。也让他成了全连第一个，也是唯一一个，因为感冒发烧被送到团部医务室来挂水的兵。所以，陆阳当下面临的问题，不是他想当什么兵种。而是应该考虑，哪个兵种会愿意接纳自已？“只要不是去生产基地养猪，我都行。”“哈哈哈哈......”何镇涛被陆阳这番话给逗笑了。他直言，生产基地养猪这些话，都是编出来骗骗新兵的。团里花这么大代价自已带兵，自已搞训练，为的就是多培养一些好苗子。并且生产基地要求也是十分严格的，不是什么样的人都能去，还得经过一段时间的畜牧种植类专业技能培训才行。陆阳这才恍然大悟，合着那些动不动就说把你送去养猪，都是吓唬他们这些新兵的？“不说这个，先吃东西吧。”陆阳的水挂完了，何镇涛叫来卫生员拔了针管，递给他一双筷子。这是一顿标标准准的病号饭，青菜面条炖的烂烂糊糊，鸡蛋也都打碎了混在汤里。闻着香喷喷，吃到肚子里更是暖洋洋的，尤其是上头点缀的几滴小磨香油，还真就让他吃出了点儿家的味道来。不管南北饮食差异有多大，病号饭基本都是大同小异，味道也大差不差。肚子里有食儿，陆阳脸上气色立马好了许多，拿筷子的手也有劲多了。何镇涛看着他，微笑问：“陆阳，进部队也快一个月了，你觉得部队好不好？”陆阳饿坏了，大口扒拉面条：“好，吃得好睡得好，还能学到很多新东西......”何镇涛又问：“那如果，给你们三班换一个新班长，你能接受吗？”陆阳动作停下，不可置信的抬起头，看向坐在对面床铺上的指导员：“换个班长？”何镇涛点头：“以目前情况来看，周凯东已经不再适合继续开展新训工作，所以借着这次机会，我准备向团里申请换个人来带你们，你觉得怎么样？”“不好！”陆阳不像先前那般犹豫，而是果断拒绝。这让何镇涛很是诧异：“理由呢？”陆阳认真回答：“班长虽然训练时候严厉了些，但私底下人很好，也为我们付出了很多辛苦。”何镇涛拧着眉头：“可是，你应该能够看得出来，他这些天明显不在状态。这样下去，对于你们来说很不公平，甚至会直接影响到下连分配。”“咱们团没有养殖基地，也不存在被分去养猪这一说，但成绩越差越是会被分到一些偏远，艰苦，边缘化的岗位。”“下连，对于新兵的重要性不亚于高考结束填报志愿，分到什么单位往后基本上就不会再挪窝了。”陆阳还想替周凯东说两句好话，但却被何镇涛打断了。因为视角不同，思考问题的方式也不同。陆阳重感情，朝夕相处的形成习惯了。忽然换人，可能会给他不安定的感觉。但何镇涛作为新兵连指导员，看中的是三班全体新兵的未来发展。他知道，里头有一些新兵是希望在部队好好干，想留队的。如果因为班长周凯东个人的松懈，导致一些本该分到优秀单位的新兵，被分去一些没什么留队名额的地方，那就是毁人前途。所以，何镇涛必须得拿出解决办法来及时止损，拨乱反正。“陆阳，你的想法，仅能代表你个人；明天复检，我会跟你们班的人讲明利害关系，让他们匿名投票。”“只要有一个人不想受影响，投出赞成票，周凯东就必须得收拾东西离开。”“否则，这不仅是对三班新兵，同样也是对一排其他两个班的不负责任。”陆阳放下筷子，陷入沉默：“......”
content_en: Tick, tick, tick... The medicine bottle hangs upside down on the stand, and drops of transparent potion fall into the dropper, making small splashes rhythmically.On the bed in the regimental infirmary, Lu Yang slowly opened his eyes and looked up at the medicine bottle above his head.There are about half a bottle left, and it will take at least an hour to finish them all.It turned out that Lu Yang's fever had gone away last night.As a result, the fever suddenly returned in the middle of the night, accompanied by severe coughing.So the instructor got up overnight and drove him here to get some water.The mobile medical examination vehicle of the field hospital happened to be conducting physical examinations for the key members of the regiment, and the accompanying doctors were all regular doctors from tertiary hospitals.After taking his temperature and asking about his symptoms, he was given a few bottles of water.Two bottles were hung last night, and this time during the day there are two bottles of water, one large and one small.During this process, Lu Yang fell asleep several times. The fever gradually subsided and his head was no longer so hot.The regiment's infirmary was not large, with the earliest green-and-white-walled interior. There were only two beds in total, and there was no TV set on the wall.It was a bit boring to wait, so Lu Yang picked up a "Field First Aid Manual" on the cabinet next to him and read it.This is an entry-level simple first aid guide. It doesn’t have a lot of content, but it teaches very basic and practical things.Including, how to clean wounds in the field, how to use bandages correctly, how to splint the injured with fractures, etc.Because the content was quite interesting, Lu Yang found Jingjing interesting, and his originally slightly groggy head seemed to gradually become clearer.Only then did he remember that under the influence of the system, he could improve his physical fitness by learning professional knowledge related to the army.Perhaps, the effect is not particularly obvious, but it is better than nothing, and it can just pass the time.At this moment, the door of the infirmary was pushed open, and He Zhentao walked in carrying a thermos bucket.Seeing that Lu Yang was awake and leaning on the bed reading a book seriously, he immediately smiled."Are you awake?" "Hello, instructor." Lu Yang wanted to raise his hand to salute, but he pushed him back."You are a patient, so you don't need it." "I asked the cafeteria to prepare a separate meal for patients. You can eat it while it's hot later." He Zhentao unscrewed the thermos box and found a piece of rotten egg and vegetable noodles with a few drops of ground sesame oil.Lu Yang vomited several times yesterday and his stomach was empty. Now that he smelled the fragrance, he was really hungry."It's a bit hot. Let's put it aside to dry. It happens that your bottle of water is almost finished. Eat it after you finish." "Okay." While waiting, He Zhentao took the "Field First Aid Manual" over and deliberately joked."What, you want to be a medical soldier?" "No, just looking around to pass the time." "Then what kind of military branch do you want to be after joining the company?" "Um..." The instructor's words immediately stopped Lu Yang.What he is currently good at is organizing housekeeping, publishing blackboard reports, and commenting on news.Although the team is doing well, it is not the best; physical fitness is only average among the entire company; and in terms of physical fitness, it is probably ranked at the bottom.When he decided to give up his studies and sign up to join the army, his parents were worried that the army would not want him.At that time, Lu Yang still felt a little hurtful and heart-wrenching.But in fact, his parents did know his physical condition better than Lu Yang.As people age, they tend to selectively forget many bad things in their memories.For example, Lu Yang clearly remembers that his health was not very good when he was a child, and he often went to the hospital. He even contracted pneumonia during the Chinese New Year, which made the whole family panic.However, the age boundary between the words "when I was a child" is already blurred. As an adult, Lu Yang always couldn't wait to cut himself off from "when he was a child" in order to show that he was no longer "frail and sickly".A large part of the reason for doing this is also because the word "frail" is usually equated with "virtual".Lu Yang is a pure man, so naturally he will not admit that he is "empty", so he subjectively modified his memory, mistakenly thinking that he has now got rid of the three words "medicine jar".But in fact, until he started working, his physical fitness was still not much improved.Whenever there is a flu outbreak season, he is among the first to be infected.But due to the pressure of life, he did not have the time or opportunity to go to the hospital for injections and fluids like he did when he was a child, so he could only take medicine to cope.Over time, there is an illusion that immunity is stronger than before, but this is not the case.And a winter rain broke Lu Yang's dignity and exposed the lies he had carefully concocted for himself.He also made him the first and only soldier in the company to be sent to the regimental infirmary for fluid treatment because of a cold and fever.Therefore, the problem Lu Yang faces now is not which military branch he wants to be.Instead, you should consider, which military branch will be willing to accept you?"As long as I don't go to the production base to raise pigs, I'll do it." "Hahahaha..." He Zhentao was amused by Lu Yang's words.He bluntly said that the words about raising pigs in production bases were all made up to deceive new recruits.The regiment spent so much money to lead its own troops and conduct its own training in order to cultivate more good seedlings.Moreover, the requirements for the production base are also very strict. Not all kinds of people can go there, and they must undergo a period of professional skills training in animal husbandry and planting.Lu Yang suddenly realized that those who kept saying that they would send you to raise pigs were all trying to scare them, the new recruits?"Don't talk about that, let's eat first." After Lu Yang finished drinking water, He Zhentao called the hygienist to pull out the syringe and handed him a pair of chopsticks.This is a standard hospital meal. The vegetables and noodles are stewed to a pulp, and the eggs are broken and mixed in the soup.It smelled delicious and felt warm in the stomach after eating it, especially the few drops of ground sesame oil on top, which really gave him a taste of home.No matter how different the diets between the north and the south are, the meals for sick patients are basically the same and taste pretty much the same.With food in his stomach, Lu Yang's face immediately looked much better, and his hands holding chopsticks became much stronger.He Zhentao looked at him and asked with a smile: "Lu Yang, it's been almost a month since I joined the army. Do you think the army is good?" Lu Yang was so hungry that he ate a lot of noodles: "Okay, I eat well, sleep well, and learn a lot of new things..." He Zhentao asked again: "Then if a new squad leader is given to your third class, will you accept it?" Lu Yang stopped and couldn't believe it.He raised his head and looked at the instructor sitting on the bed opposite: "Change the squad leader?" He Zhentao nodded: "Judging from the current situation, Zhou Kaidong is no longer suitable to continue the new training work, so taking this opportunity, I am going to apply to the regiment for someone to replace you. What do you think?" "No!" Lu Yang was not as hesitant as before, but refused decisively.This made He Zhentao very surprised: "What's the reason?" Lu Yang answered seriously: "Although the squad leader was a little strict during training, he is a very nice person in private and has worked hard for us." He Zhentao frowned: "But, you should be able to see that he is obviously out of shape these days. If this continues, it will be very unfair to you, and it will even directly affect the distribution of the lower companies."Our regiment does not have a breeding base, and there is no such thing as being assigned to raise pigs, but the worse the performance, the more remote, difficult, and marginalized positions will be assigned.""The lower company is as important to recruits as filling out their application for the college entrance examination. They will basically not move again after being assigned to any unit."Lu Yang also wanted to say a few good words for Zhou Kaidong, but was interrupted by He Zhentao.Because the perspectives are different, the way of thinking about the problem is also different.Lu Yang values ​​​​love and has developed a habit of spending time together day and night.A sudden substitution may give him an unsettled feeling.But as the instructor of the recruit company, He Zhentao is focused on the future development of all the recruits in the third class.He knew that there were some new recruits who wanted to do well in the army and stay in the army.If due to squad leader Zhou Kaidong's personal laxity, some recruits who should be assigned to excellent units are assigned to places with few places to stay on the team, it will ruin their futures.Therefore, He Zhentao must come up with solutions to stop losses in time and bring order to the chaos."Lu Yang, your thoughts can only represent you personally; for the re-examination tomorrow, I will explain the stakes to your class and let them vote anonymously." "As long as one person does not want to be affected and votes in favor, Zhou Kaidong will have to pack up and leave." "Otherwise, this will be irresponsible not only to the recruits in the third class, but also to the other two classes in the first platoon." Lu Yang put down his chopsticks and fell into silence: "..."
